title: Test plan
description: Written from the acceptance criteria, the profile's baseline quality requirements and the current behaviour only, without the design spec. Every test case traces to one requirement: an acceptance criterion or a quality requirement.

quality_requirements.description: Non-functional requirements for this change: those stated in the ticket, the profile baseline items that apply, and any you derive by walking the ISO/IEC 25010 product quality characteristics (e.g. performance efficiency, reliability, security, maintainability) against the change. Empty only if none apply.

id.description: NFR<n>, e.g. NFR1, or the profile's own id for baseline items.

source.description: derived: proposed by you. Failures of derived requirements are reported to the user, not sent back to the implementer.

characteristic.description: ISO/IEC 25010 characteristic and sub-characteristic, e.g. 'performance efficiency / time behaviour'.

metric.description: What is measured, e.g. 'p95 response time of get-order-history', 'buffers read per call', 'error log event emitted with trace id'.

threshold.description: The limit. For yes/no checks use 1 for 'must hold'.

op.description: How the measured value compares to the threshold to pass. Default <=.

valid_on.description: The smallest environment where a measurement proves it. Plan shape proves on a stand; timings at production size and real load prove only on production, which the user checks.

test_cases.description: At least one per acceptance criterion and per quality requirement, plus negative cases (missing, deleted, malformed input).

id.description: TC-<requirement id>-<n>, e.g. TC-AC2-1, TC-NFR1-1. Unique.

requirement_id.description: The acceptance criterion or quality requirement this case proves.

level.description: operational: logs, metrics, traces, alerts and dashboards the change must produce.

runs_on.description: local: an automated test in the build record. stand: run by the system tester and recorded in the test report. production: a check handed to the user.

negative.description: True for missing, deleted or malformed input cases.

preconditions.description: Data and state required. On the stand: records to seed through the real pipeline, or existing ones to reuse.

expected.description: The exact observable result. For quality requirements: the metric against its threshold.

entry_criteria.description: What must hold before stand testing starts, e.g. 'CI green on the head'.

exit_criteria.description: What must hold to call testing done.

quality_requirements.statement: Order history reads only the versions it returns, at any history length.
quality_requirements.metric: history rows read per call for an order with 2000 versions

quality_requirements.statement: A failed history request is logged with the order id and trace id.
quality_requirements.metric: error log event with order id and trace id

test_cases.title: History lists every saved version newest first
History page shows the version used for shipping
test_cases.preconditions: seeded order O-1 with 3 versions, shipped after version 1

test_cases.title: History read is bounded
steps: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) the history query for it
test_cases.expected: at most 501 history rows read, through the history primary key

test_cases.title: Failure is traceable in logs
steps: request history for a malformed order id
search the stand's logs for the request's trace id
test_cases.expected: one error event carrying the order id and trace id

exit_criteria: every stand case from ticket and profile requirements passes
